card.name: Verbs and links in label warnings
card.fires_on: Small linking or verb words in drug-label warning sentences, such as 'whether' after 'It is unknown', 'occur' or 'occurred' after a named adverse condition, and 'Never' before crush or chew.

modes.label: Unknown whether
modes.description: The word 'whether' after 'It is unknown' in pediatric-use statements.
modes.example: It is unknown<< whether>> the risk of suicidal thoughts and behaviors in

modes.label: Occur after adverse event
modes.description: The verb 'occur' or 'occurred' following a named serious condition in treated patients.
modes.example: pneumonitis can<< occur>> in patients treated with GAVRETO

modes.label: Sentence-opening instruction
modes.description: A sentence-starting word such as 'Never' or 'Although' right after a dosing sentence.
modes.example: Swallow whole.<< Never>> crush, cut, or chew (
